title: Dump and Bake Chicken & Hashbrown Casserole (Partial — Video Only)

notes: Partial — video only. Creator Jenicaecho calls this her favorite 'dump and bake' meal: a casserole that appears to have shredded hash browns/potatoes, chicken, cheddar cheese, and a crispy French fried onion topping, baked until golden.
